strategy10Days.title: Filter & Apply Within First 24 Hours of Posting
strategy10Days.description: Recruiters review the first 30-50 applicants. Applying on Day 5 drops callback chances to below 3%. Use the 'Today (< 24h)' freshness filter on Naukri and LinkedIn.

strategy10Days.title: 90%+ ATS Keyword Injection
strategy10Days.description: Every ATS (Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, Lever, Naukri) screens resumes algorithmically. Ensure mandatory keywords (Playwright, RestAssured, ISO 8583, POM, JIRA, TestNG, Boundary Value) appear verbatim in your application.

strategy10Days.title: Highlight Immediate Notice Period Advantage
strategy10Days.description: 80% of recruiters reject 90-day notice candidates. Prominently display: '30 Days Notice Period (Negotiable / Immediate Buyout Available)' on your headline and recruiter messages.

strategy10Days.title: 2-Step Direct Recruiter & Hiring Manager Outreach
strategy10Days.description: Don't just click Apply. Send a direct LinkedIn connection note or email to the Technical Recruiter / QA Engineering Manager using the pre-built 1-click outreach templates.
